fullPassage: Do you know one of the best remedies for coping with family tension? Two words: "I'm sorry." It's amazing how hard some people find them to say. They think that it implies weakness or defeat. Nothing of the kind. In fact, it is exactly the opposite. Another good way of relieving tension is a row! The sea is ever so much calmer after a storm. A row has another advantage. When tempers are raised, unspoken truths usually come out. They may hurt a bit, especially at the time. Yet, at the end, you know each other a bit better. Lastly, most of the tensions and quarrels between children are natural. Even when they seem to be constant, wise parents don't worry too much.

❌ ② 영구적 손상 — 본문은 갈등이 관계 개선에 도움된다고 긍정

det.tip: S4: exactly the opposite + S10: know each other better — 갈등 해소 후 더 나은 이해가 요지.
